generation.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Produce one professional dealer-logo asset on a truly transparent background. Wide horizontal lockup with a separate compact emblem at left, generous transparent gap, and the exact business name at right in bold custom geometric lettering. The emblem must stay clear at 32px, thick strokes and few shapes. Flat crisp vector-like artwork; no gradients, no shadows, no mockup, no photography, no extra text. Every dark element must have a fine white outer keyline and every white element a dark navy outline, so this identical master works on white, charcoal #111113 and dark red #c40101. Use a clean solid silhouette, not decorative outlines. This is an independent proposal, not dealer-approved artwork. Exact name: SMALL AUTOMATICS. Left emblem a compact S inside one rounded-corner open-square form, inspired by simple automatic gear selection but without tiny letters or gear teeth. Royal blue #255bba and white with dark navy. Exact two-line wordmark SMALL / AUTOMATICS; both lines bold legible, no tiny tagline.
